reference: Oracle Primavera P6 EPPM REST API Release 26
purpose: First controlled typed-semantic evidence tranche. This artifact records Oracle API types and explicit computation/update wording without changing the canonical registry.

fields.evidence: Oracle explicitly states AccountingVariance is computed as planned value minus actual cost.
Oracle explicitly states actual duration is computed from actual start/finish or data date using the activity calendar.
Oracle states it is computed from actual labor units and default price when no resources are assigned; assignment-derived behavior also applies.
Oracle defines the value but the endpoint schema alone does not certify storage/mutability semantics.
Oracle defines the actual start date; update capability alone is insufficient to certify field mutability semantics.
Oracle defines the actual finish date; update capability alone is insufficient to certify field mutability semantics.
Oracle explicitly gives the formula (planned duration - remaining duration) / planned duration * 100.
Oracle states it is tied to duration, units, or physical percent complete according to PercentCompleteType.
Oracle states physical percent complete can be user-entered or calculated from weighted activity steps.
Oracle states performance percent complete is used for earned value and depends on the WBS earned-value technique.
Oracle states planned duration is working time between planned start and finish using the activity calendar.
Oracle explicitly states the date is computed by the scheduler but can be updated manually before the activity is started.

Oracle explicitly gives the composition: planned labor + nonlabor + material + expense cost.
Oracle explicitly states it is the sum of planned labor and planned nonlabor units.
